findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "calculate_bazi_four_pillars" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Calculate authentic Chinese BaZi Four Pillars of Destiny (Year, Month, Day, Hour Stems & Branches), True Solar Time correction, Day Master (Ri Yuan) archetype, and Five Elements (Wu Xing) balance." → after: "Calculate Year, Month, Day, and Hour Four Pillars of Destiny (BaZi) with astronomical Equation of Time and birth-longitude True Solar Time correction."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "generate_poetic_chinese_name" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.
